nodes.name: ResFinder Phenotype Parser
nodes.description: Parses ResFinder results and pheno_table into structured AMR resistance profiles and matrices

args_template:
import os, json, sys
src = '{resfinder_dir}'
out = '{work_dir}'
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
# Parse AMR results
amr_file = os.path.join(src, 'ResFinder_results_tab.txt')
amr_data = []
if os.path.exists(amr_file):
    with open(amr_file) as f:
        lines = [l.strip().split('\t') for l in f if l.strip()]
        if len(lines) > 1:
            for p in lines[1:]:
                if len(p) >= 4:
                    amr_data.append({'gene': p[0], 'identity': float(p[1]) if p[1].replace('.','',1).isdigit() else 100.0, 'alignment': p[2], 'coverage': float(p[3]) if p[3].replace('.','',1).isdigit() else 100.0, 'phenotype': p[7] if len(p) > 7 else 'Resistant'})
with open(os.path.join(out, 'amr_genes.json'), 'w') as f:
    json.dump(amr_data, f, indent=2)
# Parse Phenotypes
pheno_file = os.path.join(src, 'pheno_table.txt')
pheno_data = []
if os.path.exists(pheno_file):
    with open(pheno_file) as f:
        lines = [l.strip().split('\t') for l in f if l.strip()]
        if len(lines) > 1:
            for p in lines[1:]:
                if len(p) >= 3:
                    p_str = p[2]
                    pheno_data.append({'antimicrobial': p[0], 'class': p[1] if len(p)>1 else '', 'phenotype': p_str, 'resistant': 'resis' in p_str.lower(), 'genetic_background': p[3] if len(p)>3 else ''})
with open(os.path.join(out, 'phenotype_profile.json'), 'w') as f:
    json.dump(pheno_data, f, indent=2)
# Parse Point mutations
point_file = os.path.join(src, 'PointFinder_results.txt')
point_data = []
if os.path.exists(point_file):
    with open(point_file) as f:
        lines = [l.strip().split('\t') for l in f if l.strip()]
        if len(lines) > 1:
            for p in lines[1:]:
                if len(p) >= 3:
                    point_data.append({'mutation': p[0], 'nucleotide_change': p[1] if len(p)>1 else '', 'amino_acid_change': p[2] if len(p)>2 else '', 'phenotype': p[3] if len(p)>3 else 'Resistant'})
with open(os.path.join(out, 'point_mutations.json'), 'w') as f:
    json.dump(point_data, f, indent=2)
